shellCommands.command: ls -a && cat package.json && cat AGENTS.md && find .agents -type f | head -50 && git ls-files | head -50

sed -n 1,80p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; grep -n -i -C3 "calendar\|date-components\|date-utils" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | sed -n 1,120p; cat src/App.tsx src/main.tsx index.html; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui; ls __agent_eval__
npm view @gravity-ui/date-components version peerDependencies 2>&1 | tail -20; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | grep '"version"'

npm view @gravity-ui/date-components versions --json | tr -d '\n ' | grep -o '"[0-9]*\.[0-9]*\.[0-9]*"' | tail -40 | tr '\n' ' '; echo; for v in 3.0.0 3.1.0 3.2.0 3.3.0 4.0.0; do echo "== $v"; npm view @gravity-ui/date-components@$v peerDependencies 2>&1 | grep -E "uikit|date-utils"; done

npm view @gravity-ui/date-components@4.1.0 peerDependencies | grep -E "uikit|date-utils"; npm install @gravity-ui/date-components@^4.1.0 @gravity-ui/date-utils@^2.6.0 2>&1 | tail -8; grep '"version"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/package.json node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-utils/package.json; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/{dist,build}/docs 2>&1 | head
cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/docs && cat INDEX.md | head -60; ls -R components | head -30
